title: Isle of Quel'Danas
body: The Isle of Quel'Danas rises from the sea north of Eversong, and on its plateau lies the Sunwell, kindled by Dath'Remar's people with water carried from the Well of Eternity. In the Third War Arthas used it to raise Kel'Thuzad, and the defiled well was lost to the elves. Now the forces of Prince Kael'thas hold the island for the Burning Legion, and the Shattered Sun Offensive has landed to win it back, piece by piece.

parts.body: On the plateau Kael'thas's servants and their demon allies work to reignite the Sunwell, and they mean its power for the Legion.
In the end the Legion's designs failed. Kil'jaeden was turned back, the Sunwell burns pure once more, and the Farstriders guard the plateau, though the Offensive's war on the island goes on.

body: The Shattered Sun Staging Area is where the Offensive musters its newcomers. A draenei, Exarch Larethor, commands here beside a blood elf, Captain Theris Dawnhearth, and the drill sergeant greets each new draft bluntly: Aldor and Scryer alike will work together or go home on the boat.

title: Sun's Reach
body: Sun's Reach, the town on the isle's northern shore, is the Offensive's first goal. Lacking the numbers to storm it, the Offensive means to take it a piece at a time: first the sanctum, overrun by the Wretched, then the armory, held by the Legion's demons, and last the harbor, held by the Dawnblade, Kael's elite. South of the town a fel portal in the Dawning Square pours in demons, and the Dawnblade hold Dawnstar Village to the west.

parts.body: The sanctum has been won, and beside it a portal from Shattrath now opens, kept alive by mana cells seized again and again from the ethereals of Outland.
sources: quest 11496 description (Wretched stole the ward power sources; sanctum energy to open a portal from Shattrath)

parts.body: The armory has fallen and the demons have been pushed back to the Dawning Square, and behind it a forge now arms the Offensive with iron taken from the naga.

parts.body: The harbor has fallen and the Dawnblade have been driven out. Sun's Reach belongs to the Offensive, and beside the sanctum a monument honors those who died to win it.

title: Greengill Coast
body: Greengill Coast, on the eastern shore southeast of Sun's Reach, was home to a village of Greengill murlocs until the Darkspine naga came. Their sirens bind the murlocs with controlling orbs and set them to digging iron ore, which the naga lock in chests for the Legion, and on a ley line near the shore they have raised a shrine to Queen Azshara.

title: The Dead Scar of Quel'Danas
body: The Dead Scar does not end at Silvermoon. On the isle it climbs from the southern shore toward the Sunwell Plateau, and its blight still stirs the dead. The Burning Legion has claimed the same ground, and the two hosts are locked in a struggle that keeps the demons too busy to fall upon the Offensive, at least for now.

parts.body: At its southern end lie the remains of Thalorien Dawnseeker, the last wielder of Quel'Delar, who fell here holding the road against the Scourge.

title: Thalorien Dawnseeker
body: Thalorien Dawnseeker was a high elf warrior and bearer of Quel'Delar, a sword given to his people long ago, which he carried against the Amani in the Troll Wars. When the Scourge came for the Sunwell he fell on the ground now called the Dead Scar, holding the road so that his soldiers could prepare the well's defenses. His sword was found long after in Icecrown, broken and defiled.

parts.body: Called up by one who bears Quel'Delar, his spirit relives his last stand against the Scourge and the death knight Morlen Coldgrip, then names the bearer the sword's heir and gives his blessing.
